name: Fake "LayerZero" Token
rootCause: A fake "LayerZero" token on the BSC chain has had a lot of liquidity removed. The deployer removed 4,827.99 WBNB worth about $1 million. The contract address of the fake token is 0x2266362f414Bf2476C5465dc2eA953Fe2A99AE1c.
